tools.name: agentic_fetch
tools.description_prefix: Fetch a URL or search the web using an AI sub-agent that can extract, summarize, and answer questions. Slower and costlier than fetch; use fetch for raw content or API responses.

tools.name: bash
tools.description_prefix:
Execute shell commands; long-running commands automatically move to background and return a shell ID.

tools.name: download
tools.description_prefix: Download a URL directly to a local file (binary-safe, streaming, max 600s timeout); overwrites without warning. For reading content into context use fetch.

tools.name: edit
tools.description_prefix: Edit a file by exact find-and-replace; can also create or delete content. If old_string differs from the file only in whitespace, the matching lines are still edited and new_string is re-indented to t

tools.name: fetch
tools.description_prefix: Fetch raw content from a URL as text, markdown, or html (max 100KB); no AI processing. For analysis or extraction use agentic_fetch. For GitHub content when an exact repo, issue, or PR link is provide

tools.name: glob
tools.description_prefix: Find files by name/pattern (glob syntax), sorted by modification time; max 100 results; skips hidden files. Use grep to search file contents.

tools.name: grep
tools.description_prefix: Search file contents by regex or literal text; returns matching file paths sorted by modification time (max 100); respects .gitignore. Use glob to filter by filename, not contents.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description_prefix:
Terminate a background shell process.

<usage>

- Cancels the running process and cleans up resources
</usage>

tools.name: job_output
tools.description_prefix: Get stdout/stderr from a background shell by ID; set wait=true to block until completion.

tools.name: ls
tools.description_prefix: List files and directories as a tree; skips hidden files and common system dirs; max 1000 files. Use glob to find files by pattern, grep to search contents.

tools.name: lsp_call_hierarchy
tools.description_prefix: Show the call hierarchy for a symbol — either incoming calls (who calls this) or outgoing calls (what does this call). Use before refactoring to understand blast radius, or when tracing execution flow

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.description_prefix: Find the definition of a symbol by name via LSP. Prefer this over `grep` for finding where something is defined: it is language-aware and skips matches in comments, strings, and partial identifiers. R

tools.name: lsp_diagnostics
tools.description_prefix: Get LSP errors, warnings, and hints for a file or the whole project.

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.description_prefix: Find all references to a symbol by name via LSP; more accurate than grep for code symbols.

tools.name: lsp_rename
tools.description_prefix: Rename a symbol across all files using LSP rename. Prefer this over manual multi-file `edit` for any rename: it performs a true semantic rename that respects scopes, overloads, and imports automatical

tools.name: lsp_replace_symbol
tools.description_prefix: Replace, insert, or delete an entire symbol (function, method, class, struct) by name using LSP document symbols to find exact boundaries. Prefer this over `edit` for whole-symbol changes: it eliminat

tools.name: lsp_restart
tools.description_prefix: Restart one or all LSP clients by name; use when diagnostics are stale or the LSP is unresponsive.

tools.name: lsp_symbols
tools.description_prefix: List document symbols (functions, types, methods, etc.) for a file via LSP. Returns a structured outline showing symbol names, kinds, and line ranges. Use this before editing unfamiliar files to under

tools.name: multiedit
tools.description_prefix: Apply multiple find-and-replace edits to a single file in one operation; edits run sequentially. Prefer over edit for multiple changes to the same file. Same exact-match rules as edit apply.

tools.name: sourcegraph
tools.description_prefix: Search code across public GitHub repositories via Sourcegraph; supports regex, language/repo/file filters, and symbol search (max 20 results). Only searches public repos.

tools.name: todos
tools.description_prefix: Manage a structured task list for multi-step work; each task has pending/in_progress/completed state. Keep exactly one task in_progress at a time. Skip for simple or single-step tasks.

tools.name: view
tools.description_prefix: Read a file by path with line numbers; supports offset and line limit (default 200, max 200KB returned file content section); renders images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP); use ls for directories.

tools.name: write
tools.description_prefix: Create or overwrite a file with given content; auto-creates parent dirs. Cannot append. Read the file first to avoid conflicts. For surgical changes use edit or multiedit.
